Parker pushes his team to find more gold, while Tony Beets brings in new equipment to boost his mining operation. Meanwhile, Rick Ness faces challenges as he returns to mining, and newcomer Greg Gibson takes a shot at striking it rich!
Stream Full Episodes of Gold Rush
About Gold Rush
Motivated by a depressed economy, hard-working gold miners get to work both in America and across the globe in an attempt to strike it rich.
